settings.q: Do I have to be good with words?
settings.a: No. You are not writing anything. You answer five plain questions about the two of you, in your own words, and we turn those answers into lyrics.

settings.q: Do the two of us really appear in the music video?
settings.a: Yes — that is the part nobody else does. The couple on screen is built to look like you, so the video tells your story instead of a stock one.
You pick the genre and the mood. Country, soul, pop, acoustic, rap — whatever they would actually put on.

settings.q: What if I do not like it?
settings.a: You hear a free preview before you pay anything. If it is not right, you owe nothing, and if you have already ordered and you are not happy with it, you get a full refund.
A full-length song and a music video, both about the two of you, yours to keep and to share.

settings.q: Is it a good wedding gift?
settings.a: It is made for the moments where a card is not enough: a first dance, a wedding morning, an anniversary, or the gift the guests give together.
